programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Bless the Boys in Blue
programmes.d: Jonathan relinquishes his angelic powers for awhile and realizes the dangers that Mark has faced being a police officer.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Cindy
programmes.d: An aspiring actress wants to be accepted for who she really is, not in the image her well-meaning dad tries to transform her into.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: The Devil and Jonathan Smith
programmes.d: Mark has been tricked into selling his soul in order to save a little girl's life. But the Devil has another agenda: acquiring Jonathan's soul.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Birds of a Feather

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: The Smile in the Third Row
programmes.d: The lead actor in a Broadway play claims that God is attending the show's performances, sitting in a third-row orchestra seat.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: The Secret
programmes.d: The teenage daughter of Mark's friend tries to find her biological mother. It may tear the family apart.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: The Monster - Part 1
programmes.d: Jonathan and Mark connect a young blind woman with a disfigured artist.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: The Monster - Part 2
programmes.d: Jonathan and Mark's friend Scotty is on hand to provide legal assistance. He defends the young artist with a facial deformity who has been accused of assaulting a blind girl.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: The Good Doctor
programmes.d: Jonathan and Mark go to work at a football team. They learn that one of the players has been getting drugs from the team doctor.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Alone
programmes.d: A homeless boy wishes that someone would love him.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Close Encounters of the Heavenly Kind
programmes.d: Jonathan and Mark help a bullied orphan whose eccentric grandfather is in danger of losing him to a heartless social worker.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Change of Life
programmes.d: Mark switches places with an attractive movie star who has a low opinion of men.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Keep Smiling
programmes.d: Jonathan must help his own widow regain her love for life.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: The Last Assignment
programmes.d: An errant angel has been on probation for two centuries because he's always breaking the rules.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: The Bind the Wounds
programmes.d: A father attempts to have a memorial made to commemorate his son who was killed in Vietnam.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Heaven on Earth
programmes.d: Mark asks Jonathan to help erase everything bad that's happened to him recently. Mark's idea is to create his own vision of heaven on Earth.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Summit
programmes.d: A dying woman was forced to leave a son behind in the Soviet Union during World War II.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: The Torch
programmes.d: Tragedy occurs when a Neo-Nazi disputes the Holocaust with the son of a death camp survivor.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Sail Away
programmes.d: Jonathan and Mark assist a novelist who's given up. Also, they motivate the man's grandson, who has yet to tap into his literary potential.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Children's Children

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Friends
programmes.d: While working as a substitute teacher at a high school, Jonathan assigns an overweight girl to tutor a troubled baseball star.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: A Special Love - Part 1
programmes.d: Jonathan and Mark persuade a youngster with Down's Syndrome to join the Special Olympics.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: A Special Love - Part 2
programmes.d: Jonathan and Mark's friend Scotty wants to adopt the boy with Down's Syndrome. A custody battle occurs with the biological parents.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: For the Love of Larry
programmes.d: Jonathan and Mark rescue victims trapped in a car, thanks to a helpful dog.
